_comment: Claude Code project permissions for the Hermes build. Scoped for FAIL-LOUD autonomy (permission-mode acceptEdits + this allowlist), NOT approve-everything. The build DRIVER (auto_build.py) owns commit/push/merge and the release profile; Claude Code may edit source and run the portable-profile toolchain, but may not commit, push, merge, run the release build, or touch keys/secrets. This is the capability boundary that keeps unattended runs safe.

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | grep -qiE '\.(env|pem|key)$|secrets/|credentials|infra_manifest\\.json$|Cargo\.toml$|\[profile\.release\]'; then echo 'Blocked: protected file (keys/secrets/release-profile are owned by the operator, not the build agent)' >&2; exit 2; fi
